description: This file defines the class ClientControllerImpl, which implements the google::protobuf::RpcController interface for managing RPC calls within the Rialto IPC client. It includes methods for resetting the controller, checking failure status, retrieving error text, starting cancellation, and setting failure reasons. The class is part of the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace and is intended for client-side RPC control logic.

classes.name: ClientControllerImpl
classes.description: A final class implementing the google::protobuf::RpcController interface, providing control over RPC calls in the Rialto IPC client.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the RPC controller to its initial state, allowing reuse for a new call.

methods.name: Failed
methods.description: Checks if the previous RPC call has failed.

methods.name: ErrorText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the error from the last failed RPC call.

methods.name: StartCancel
methods.description: Initiates cancellation of the ongoing RPC call.

methods.name: SetFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure reason for the RPC, indicating that the call has failed.

methods.name: IsCanceled
methods.description: Checks if the RPC has been canceled.

methods.name: NotifyOnCancel
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked if the RPC is canceled.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed
methods.description: Sets the failure reason for a method call, used internally.

methods.name: setMethodCallFailed (overload)
methods.description: Sets the failure reason with formatted input, used internally.
